description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Arborize, which provides static methods to transform streams of HTMLPurifier tokens into nodes and vice versa, involving tree traversal and token processing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Arborize
classes.description: Provides static methods for transforming HTMLPurifier token streams into node trees and flattening nodes into token sequences.

methods.name: arborize
methods.description: Converts a stream of tokens into a node tree, effectively building the HTML structure as nodes.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens a node tree back into a sequence of tokens.
